access_evidence: PROBES.json reg_tga_001: TRANSPORT_ERROR — ConnectionError('Connection aborted.', RemoteDisconnected('Remote end closed connection without response')) on https://www.tga.gov.au/robots.txt. Repeated for https://www.tga.gov.au/ (read timeout) and http://www.tga.gov.au/robots.txt (ConnectionResetError 10054). https://apps.tga.gov.au/ answers HTTP 200 but its only content is a 221-byte meta-refresh to the blocked corporate site. data.gov.au CKAN package_search for 'artg' / 'therapeutic goods' returned no ARTG dataset (rows are NSW gazettes and unrelated PDFs).
blockers: www.tga.gov.au resets/closes the TCP connection from this host (RemoteDisconnected, then ConnectionResetError 10054).
No ARTG dataset is published on data.gov.au (CKAN package_search verified).
